classificationNotes.persistentGraph: Created during graph setup and retained as shared FX/Rhythm/meter infrastructure.
classificationNotes.active: Currently referenced by a TrackAudio live route or recording/overdub field.
classificationNotes.retainedIdle: Still referenced by TrackAudio but currently not routed as active.
classificationNotes.retiredFromTrack: Dynamic TrackAudio processor no longer referenced by its track; worklet callback history remains in the cumulative descriptor list.
classificationNotes.callbacksAdvancedWithinRecentWindow: At least one callback advanced within 3 seconds; this is activity evidence, not a hardware liveness guarantee.

workload.pcmSeed: deterministic stereo PCM installed through TrackAudio.restoreProjectBuffersAtomically before measurement; real Browser recording/overdub operations execute during measurement
workload.topologyDeclaration: 36 initial instrumented nodes = the unchanged 35-node full-runtime topology plus one persistent engine-owned Browser input capture tap

sharedInputCapture.label: engine-shared-input-capture
sharedInputCapture.route: synthetic stereo oscillator -> BrowserAudioEngine Input A-D FX -> engine-owned rc505-input-capture -> muted destination; no microphone/device permission requested

workload.instrumentationMemoryNote: Test-only callback instrumentation SharedArrayBuffer; this is added to the browser process memory footprint and can affect scheduling. It is not application audio memory.
